_comment: Players who join the 2026-27 pool REGARDLESS of the MPG>=12 / G>=40 rule. This file COMPOSES with that rule rather than replacing it: scripts/cardgen/generatePool.js keeps everyone the rule already admits and adds everyone named here. Keyed by the player name exactly as Basketball-Reference's per-game table spells it (a name that matches no row is reported by the generator rather than silently ignored). The value is the one-line reason, which is the whole point of the file: a bare list of names would lose why each one is here. WHY THIS EXISTS: the G>=40 half of the rule quietly drops anyone whose season was cut short by injury, star or not — the 18 names below are every player in the 2025-26 table with MPG>=25 (a real rotation or star role when healthy) and G<40, found and decided on 2026-08-28. Ty Jerome is a separate case: a direct individual pick, not an injury exception. See memory/new_season_player_pool.md. NOTE ON THEIR NUMBERS, UPDATED 2026-08-30: their 2024-25 season IS now blended into their 2025-26 one, volume-weighted per stat by exactly the fold that already pools the playoffs (scripts/cardgen/priorSeasonBlend.js). It used to be impossible — the EPM/EW source locked every prior season and Basketball-Reference carries neither stat — and the dunksandthrees API key removed that obstacle, so the prior season is now the SAME numbers rather than a substitute for them. This list is therefore also the blend list: it is the ONLY set of players whose card reads two seasons, and adding a name here now does two things rather than one. The blend reaches the Speed/Power budget, the shooting three and Def Boost, all of which read that row; it does not reach the scoring chart, which is built from dunksandthrees' PREDICTED per-100 rates and is already regressed for a short sample at source.
Ty Jerome: individual pick, asked for by name 2026-08-29 — 15 G at 22.6 MPG, fails both halves of the rule and is not an injury-star case
